# stripe_product_feature (Data Source)

An entitlement feature attached to a product. `terraform destroy` detaches the feature from the product and leaves the `stripe_entitlements_feature` in place. Import with `<product_id>/<product_feature_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_product_feature" "gold_search" {
  product = stripe_product.gold.id
  id      = stripe_product_feature.gold_search.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product` (String) The ID of the parent object.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the object.

### Read-Only

- `entitlement_feature` (String) The ID of the [Feature](https://docs.stripe.com/api/entitlements/feature) object attached to this product.
- `livemode` (Boolean) If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
